stage0068a_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$サリィ$$
「Damn it...!
　We drove them this far, and yet...」

stage0068a_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$マリーメイア$$ Soldier
「Did you see that, you Federation dog!」

stage0068a_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$マリーメイア$$ Soldier
「We'll live as we please!
　Taking orders from no one!」

stage0068a_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$サリィ$$
「Remnants of the $$マリーメイア$$ army...
　Do they intend to become bandits like this...」

stage0068a_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$マリーメイア$$ Soldier
「We need funds to make our escape.
　Let's get them from the village up ahead」

stage0068a_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$マリーメイア$$ Soldier
「Wait!
　Something's coming!」

stage0068a_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$マリーメイア$$ Soldier
「Wha, what is that...
　A Gundam that helped the $$マリーメイア$$ army」

stage0068a_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$マリーメイア$$ Soldier
「Seems you've had it rough too,
　ever since the Battle of Brussels」

stage0068a_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$マリーメイア$$ Soldier
「Why not come along with us?
　We could hire you on as a bodyguard」

stage0068a_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$マリーメイア$$ Soldier
「Justice...?
　What are you talking about now?」

stage0068a_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$五飛$$
「Answer.
　Didn't you fight, believing in the justice
　that $$マリーメイア$$ and $$デキム$$ spoke of?」

stage0068a_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$五飛$$
「Even if he falls,
　doesn't that conviction live on?」

stage0068a_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$マリーメイア$$ Soldier
「Cut it out.
　There may have been guys like that,
　but we were just trying to back a winner」

stage0068a_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$マリーメイア$$ Soldier
「That's right.
　We got this $$サーペント$$ as severance pay,
　and now we'll live as we please in it」

stage0068a_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$五飛$$
「...You aren't soldiers who fought for your beliefs...」

stage0068a_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$五飛$$
「Nor are you soldiers who lost their place
　in peacetime. You are...」

stage0068a_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$マリーメイア$$ Soldier
「The nerve, saying that...!」

stage0068a_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$マリーメイア$$ Soldier
「What's wrong with that!
　It's this kind of world anyway!
　We're...」

stage0068a_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$五飛$$
「I've no right to speak of justice or evil now...」

stage0068a_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$五飛$$
「Tell me, Nataku...
　What should I live for now...」

stage0068a_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$サリィ$$
「$$五飛$$...
　Are you... lost in doubt...」

stage0068a_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$星刻$$
「That man will surely find his own answer...」
